note: These are the attestation SIGNING keys the csoai.org estate uses for measurement cards, public-root envelopes, site releases and estate chains — measurement, never certification. Publishing them here is key discovery, not transparency-service operation: the estate anchors its signed artifacts to OTHER parties' transparency services (Rekor, OpenTimestamps/Bitcoin, EAS on Base) rather than operating one. A key appearing here proves only that artifacts signed by it can be pinned to did:web:csoai.org; it is not an endorsement, a conformity mark, or a claim that any artifact's contents are correct.
expiry_policy: Keys are valid until superseded. Rotations are announced append-only in https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json; superseded keys remain published (marked superseded, with reason) so historical artifacts stay verifiable forever.
